publication_note: Integrator verified remote main contains this source checkpoint and exact published tree. Native binaries remain frozen shared-worktree builds with separately qualified provenance; publication is not a reproducible rebuild or proof of every original linked input.
evidence_delivery: Compact report and checksums only in this repository; original screenshots, binary, archives and raw trace are retained locally, not public repository links.
documentation_audit: Read existing receipts/reports, checked retained evidence and screenshot hash manifests; no new build, native window, code change or Git-index operation.
status: original fixed APP-05 contract bounded verified; sampled native coherence repair accepted with explicit limitations

source.archive_validation: All 458 archived entries matched their frozen manifest in native QA; not a single published-commit build or a reproducibility claim.

headless.scope_note: Overlapping scoped checks inspected from retained logs. Not a new full-workspace run.

limits: Finite supported property set: solid fill/opacity, x/y and width/height on Rect/Ellipse/Text/Image/Box/Frame. Arbitrary properties/rotation/scale/skew and broader interpolation are explicit exclusions, not missing fixed acceptance axes.
33 timestamped state-only captures, not every vsync or zero-latency/FPS proof.
12 blank/loading captures after viewport/canonical hard invalidations are expected and preserved; this is not a globally flicker-free claim.
Screenshots occur after input; exact accepted input geometry comes from trace, not inferred simultaneous pixels.
Wheel post-dispatch accepted geometry may be absent because the viewport was just invalidated.
No background-property mutation, Image/animated-alpha content, driver failure injection, hardware cross-DPR/multi-monitor or cross-platform native proof.
Close during visible named transition exited normally; exact CPU worker busy state is unproven.
SceneEvent.local_position remains canonical; picking uses accepted displayed geometry.

Button inheritance, six shape sizes, reactive-layout projection, accepted animated-alpha hits, late ABA completion, fractional guard, accepted-empty recovery, upload failure and retirement saturation have automated coverage; this card/text native pass does not physically establish them all.

requirement_evidence.physical_scope: Hover/press/focus/disabled overlap sampled in frozen native run; selection priority covered by model tests.

requirement_evidence.code: SceneStateStyles::set_named_geometry and existing named/button state resolution
requirement_evidence.physical_scope: Named move/reversal exercised; parent/grandparent palette/flag inheritance remains automated coverage.
Intermediate hover/press/focus/named frames and reversals sampled; exhaustive timing precedence is automated.

requirement_evidence.code: StateGeometry x/y and six validated built-in width/height; non-mutating property preview and shared numeric/color sampler
requirement_evidence.physical_scope: Frame x/width/height transitions, accepted-hit checks, canonical edit/Undo/Redo sampled; all six shapes/reactive layout remain automated.

fixed_contract_review.scope_decision: Arbitrary attributes/rotation/scale/skew were not in the frozen required set; their unsupported status is an explicit boundary, not an added failure criterion.

screenshot_evidence_format.interpretation: Pixel values, threshold bounds and zero-difference regions describe decoded lossy JPEG desktop captures, not lossless renderer/Canvas/GPU buffer identity.
screenshot_evidence_format.preservation: Original capture bytes/filenames, raw QA reports, historical measurements and recorded hashes are unchanged; retained raw reports predate this format correction.
screenshot_evidence_format.independent_evidence: Runtime traces, generation/snapshot/path-replay checks, source/binary hashes, native exits and qualitative window observations retain their separate scope.
